item.description:
Every control in the panel now answers the first click — previously the first click on a switch or button was silently swallowed and it took a second one.

And a beta experiment: Breathe, under Actions. A five-minute break — the waveform grows to fill the screen and you breathe with it, a gentle two-tone sound underneath. Headphones only (the sound genuinely doesn't work through speakers); any key ends it early. Tell Richard how the five minutes feels.
